program.description: Path to the program folder (or any file within that folder) when in 'debug' or 'test' mode, or to the pre-built binary file to debug in 'exec' mode.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the debugged program.

cwd.description: Workspace relative or absolute path to the working directory of the program being debugged. Default is the current workspace.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the program.

buildFlags.description: Build flags to pass to the Go compiler.

remotePath.description: The path to the source code on the remote machine (for remote debugging).

port.description: The port to connect to (for remote debugging).

host.description: The host to connect to (for remote debugging).

trace.description: Enable logging of the Debug Adapter Protocol.

showLog.description: If true, show log output from the debugger.

substitutePath.description: Path mappings to apply to source paths sent to the debugger.

processId.description: The process ID to attach to.
